analysis.summary: Zenoti and Mangomint are publishing hard: customer stories and how-to help pages. Boulevard leans on comparison pages and case studies, while Phorest runs a podcast and event machine.

points.text: Zenoti published 21 case studies this month, mostly new, and made its own Boulevard comparison page. It is chasing multi-location buyers.
Boulevard has 3 new comparison pages and 2 new case studies. Its 21 updates mostly refresh landing and comparison pages.
Mangomint added 64 new pages, mostly how-to help pages on payroll, phones and its AI receptionist (software that answers calls). That targets its own customers.

Boulevard.play: Comparison pages, case studies with hard numbers, and product pages for buyers ready to switch.

Zenoti.play: Mass customer stories plus fresh 2026 comparison pages against Boulevard, Mangomint, Pabau, Phorest and Aesthetic Record.

Mindbody.play: No new or updated pages this period; it removed 20, including several comparison pages.

Vagaro.play: No new or updated pages this period; mostly templated /pro/ pages.

Mangomint.play: Many how-to help pages, payroll setup guides, and a launch of its Mira AI receptionist.

Phorest.play: Podcast episodes, owner-summit coverage, opinion pieces, and med spa and multi-location pages.

Fresha.play: Only 4 pages on the site and no activity this period.

shared.title: Comparison pages
shared.text: Boulevard (8), Zenoti (6) and Phorest (18) publish rival comparison pages. Zenoti's include Boulevard and Mangomint, so switchers will see rival framing of Boulevard.

shared.title: AI receptionist push
shared.text: Mangomint launched Mira, and Zenoti's pages mention an AI receptionist and AI scribe. Phorest has an AI episode. AI calls are becoming a selling point.

shared.title: Medspa focus
shared.text: Boulevard, Zenoti and Phorest all have medspa software pages. Zenoti's stories include several medspas. Medspas are a contested segment.

gaps.title: Switching guides
gaps.text: Only Mangomint has a 'switch without downtime' page. Boulevard could own migration steps for multi-location brands, including data, staff training and go-live timing.

gaps.title: Franchise and scale content
gaps.text: Boulevard has one new franchise comparison page and a few guides. Few rivals cover running 30+ locations, a chance to own that topic.

gaps.title: Rebuttal to Zenoti's comparison
gaps.text: Zenoti's Boulevard page is fresh and covers payroll, memberships and medspa charting. Boulevard could answer those topics point by point.

versus.Zenoti: Publishes 21 case studies versus Boulevard's 6, and has a page attacking Boulevard. Boulevard's stories carry sharper numbers in titles.
versus.Mindbody: Silent this period and trimming comparison pages, while Boulevard keeps refreshing its own. Little content pressure from them now.
versus.Vagaro: No activity this period, while Boulevard updated its Vagaro comparison. Vagaro is not pushing content against Boulevard.
versus.Mangomint: Far more help and how-to content (41 pages) than Boulevard's 1. Boulevard has more comparison and buyer pages.
versus.Phorest: Phorest runs a large podcast and event content engine; Boulevard has almost none, and focuses on buyer pages and case studies.
versus.Fresha: Only 4 pages and no activity, so Fresha has no content play to compare with Boulevard.
